# CvBFF

> AI resume builder and CV tailoring Chrome extension. Paste any job posting and get a tailored resume, cover letter, and fit score in seconds. Pay per use — no subscription needed.

CvBFF is a Chrome extension and web app that uses AI (Claude) to generate a tailored resume and cover letter for each job a user applies to. It reads the job posting, matches it against the user's saved work experience, and produces a keyword-optimised, ATS-friendly resume in 1, 2, or 3 pages. Users get a fit score and interview prep for each application.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://cvbff.com/): Main landing page
- [Blog](https://cvbff.com/blog/): CV and job search guides
- [Privacy Policy](https://cvbff.com/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://cvbff.com/terms): Terms of service
